Definition
[affine connection]

1. ch2:2.1An affine connection on a differentiable manifold $M$ is a map \[ abla \colon \mathcal{X}(M) imes \mathcal{X}(M)\longrightarrow \mathcal{X}(M), \qquad (X,Y)\longmapsto abla _XY, \] such that, for $X,Y,Z\in \mathcal{X}(M)$ and $f,g\in \mathcal{D}(M)$,

  1. $ abla _{fX+gY}Z=f abla _XZ+g abla _YZ$;

  2. $ abla _X(Y+Z)= abla _XY+ abla _XZ$;

  3. $ abla _X(fY)=f abla _XY+X(f)Y$.
